transcript_full_pass: Can a photo of a recipe fill your shopping cart? Since November 6, some Amazon shoppers can text Alexa for shopping. Before, read the recipe, search each ingredient one by one. Now, text a photo of the recipe, and the ingredients land in your cart. One text replaces all those searches. The catch, it's invite-only in the United States, expanding over the coming weeks. Follow Media Diet for Technology Explained.
